- Initial release of ytapi-youtube-channels.
- Enables lookup of YouTube channels by handle or ID and displays channel profiles, uploads, videos, and playlists via the YTAPI API.
- Supports reading videos from individual playlists.
- Requires a YTAPI API key; free account creation is available.
- Includes paging support and batch processing for transcripts.
- Useful for creator research, monitoring new videos, or collecting video lists.
